CLINICAL TRIAL PROTOCOL
Trial ID: NCT89542370
Title: A Phase IV Study of Away in Breast Cancer
Phase: Phase I
Sponsor: Pfizer

1. STUDY OBJECTIVES
Primary Objective: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of the investigational treatment in patients with breast cancer.

Secondary Objectives:
- Assess progression-free survival
- Evaluate quality of life measures
- Determine optimal dosing regimen

2. INCLUSION CRITERIA
- Age 18-85 years
- Histologically confirmed metastatic breast cancer
- ER/PR positive and HER2 negative tumor
- ECOG performance status 0-2
- At least one measurable lesion per RECIST 1.1 criteria

3. EXCLUSION CRITERIA
- Prior participation in investigational drug study within 30 days
- Severe renal impairment (creatinine >2.5 mg/dL)
- Active infection requiring systemic therapy
- History of drug or alcohol abuse within past year

4. STUDY DESIGN
This is a Phase I randomized study designed to enroll 451 patients over 15 months.

5. INVESTIGATIONAL PRODUCT
Targeted-Therapy-456 is a monoclonal antibody designed to block key receptors associated with disease progression.

6. SAFETY CONSIDERATIONS
Patients will be monitored closely for adverse events. Specific attention will be paid to:
- Hematologic toxicities
- Hepatic function abnormalities  
- Cardiovascular events
- Gastrointestinal toxicity

7. STATISTICAL ANALYSIS PLAN
Primary endpoint will be analyzed using Kaplan-Meier methodology.

8. ADVERSE EVENT REPORTING
All serious adverse events must be reported within 24 hours to the sponsor and regulatory authorities.

CLINICAL TRIAL PROTOCOL
Trial ID: NCT16146624
Title: A Phase II Study of We in Hypertension
Phase: Phase III
Sponsor: Bristol Myers Squibb

1. STUDY OBJECTIVES
Primary Objective: To evaluate the efficacy and safety of the investigational treatment in patients with hypertension.

Secondary Objectives:
- Assess progression-free survival
- Evaluate quality of life measures
- Determine optimal dosing regimen

2. INCLUSION CRITERIA
- Age 18-85 years
- Confirmed diagnosis of Hypertension
- Adequate organ function
- Able to provide informed consent

3. EXCLUSION CRITERIA
- Severe renal impairment (creatinine >2.5 mg/dL)
- Pregnant or nursing women
- Significant cardiovascular disease
- History of drug or alcohol abuse within past year
- Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic BP >180 mmHg or diastolic BP >110 mmHg)

4. STUDY DESIGN
This is a Phase III open-label study designed to enroll 113 patients over 15 months.

5. INVESTIGATIONAL PRODUCT
Targeted-Therapy-456 is a novel small molecule inhibitor targeting specific pathways involved in hypertension.

6. SAFETY CONSIDERATIONS
Patients will be monitored closely for adverse events. Specific attention will be paid to:
- Hematologic toxicities
- Hepatic function abnormalities  
- Cardiovascular events
- Gastrointestinal toxicity

7. STATISTICAL ANALYSIS PLAN
Primary endpoint will be analyzed using Cox proportional hazards methodology.

8. ADVERSE EVENT REPORTING
All serious adverse events must be reported within 24 hours to the sponsor and regulatory authorities.
